paragraphs: Celona sells enterprise wireless that puts private 5G and Wi-Fi on one subscription, with Wi-Fi access points included at no additional cost. The company says the product is designed for the teams building the AI-native enterprise. Robotics and AI device makers are a second audience, able to embed multi-wireless connectivity into their products.

Celona Orion is deployed as an overlay that runs on existing physical infrastructure, the same cabling, switches, and network elements. Microsegmentation isolates IT and OT traffic across both Wi-Fi and private 5G. SIM-based authentication can be used on Wi-Fi as well as cellular. The platform delivers deterministic per-device, per-application quality of service on 5G.

The company says it began from the belief that enterprises deserved wireless purpose-built for their most mission-critical operations. Celona reports more than $135 million in funding. Its resources include published research, among them a study of OT and IT traffic separation in refinery and petrochemical industries.
